prompt: Find and prepare a list of vendors who manufacture or sell battery recycling equipment in the USA
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Provide a list of vendors that manufacture or sell battery recycling equipment in the USA; (2) keep items relevant to equipment/technology vendors (services-only programs count as weaker matches). PREMISE CHECKLIST: No specific factual premise in the prompt beyond the request for USA-based battery-recycling equipment vendors; no safety issues. Candidate [3] best matches the scope by including multiple established recycling equipment manufacturers/technology providers that can directly supply battery-recycling equipment (e.g., INMETCO, Eriez, Steinert, Herbold) with fewer off-scope service/program entries. Candidate [2] contains multiple company entries that are much less clearly credible/specific as equipment vendors (even with website links), making it the weakest, while Candidate [4] and [1] are more relevant than [2] but [4] includes several organizations primarily offering services/programs rather than manufacturing/selling equipment.
